# Identify the 'Record' column values for each season
records = df['Record'].astype(str)

# Find sequences of three consecutive years with the same record
consecutive_same = []
for i in range(len(records) - 2):
    if records.iloc[i] == records.iloc[i+1] == records.iloc[i+2]:
        # Get the seasons for these three consecutive years
        seasons = df['Season'].iloc[i:i+3].tolist()
        consecutive_same.append(seasons)

# The question asks for the three consecutive years, so we take the first occurrence if any
if consecutive_same:
    answer = consecutive_same[0]
else:
    answer = []
